<thought>Using the standard DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (ignoring O), for C14H13O5 we get (28 + 2 - 13)/2 = 17/2 = 8.5, which is not an integer. The most plausible integer DBE for a typical organic molecule of this size is 9, assuming a possible typo in the hydrogen count. Therefore, I will provide 9 as the integer DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
